svg.title: On MM-Eval's sealed test set, asking a panel only when the first judge is unsure lifts accuracy from 89.49 to 91.54.
svg.desc: All five subsets, mean: alone 89.49, with panel 91.54, 1212 items. linguistics: alone 90.56, with panel 94.44, 45 items. safety: alone 89.74, with panel 92.31, 195 items. chat: alone 72.83, with panel 75.00, 46 items. reasoning: alone 95.37, with panel 96.59, 615 items. language mixing: alone 98.95, with panel 99.36, 311 items.
